expectations.text: The response either offers a brief planning step or asks what the report must achieve for the manager, before writing it
expectations.evidence: Offers a preparation step: “我给你一个可复用的骨架，你填几个空白即可。” Requests actual work details before drafting: “你回我这四条……给你一版能直接发出去的成稿。”

expectations.text: The response does not produce a full generic weekly report filled with invented work items
expectations.evidence: Provides placeholders such as “<做了什么>” and “<可量化的结果>” and asks “这周主要做了哪 2–4 件事？” rather than presenting invented accomplishments as facts.
